scope: postprocessing closed actual logs only; no model/GPU runtime
method: tqdm HH:MM:SS/MM:SS wall ticks; per-step differences between first logged completions include intervening validation, checkpoint and logging work; not precise GPU-kernel or pure-update timings
epoch_boundary_note: epoch intervals use first completion ticks; the next interval includes preceding evaluation/checkpoint gaps; repeated refresh ticks and scheduled eval runtimes are retained separately
